title: Nscale, Anthropic Negotiate Second $45B AI Compute Deal
summary:
The creators of the Claude AI model are in discussions to add a new facility to their current operations at the Monarch data center campus in West Virginia. Nscale is negotiating to sell about $45 billion of computing power to Anthropic in an agreement that could be finalized in the coming days, according to people familiar with the matter cited by Bloomberg.

This potential pact would double Anthropic's hardware commitments at the site, which are worth approximately $44.6 billion per a regulatory filing for Nscale's planned initial public offering. The existing 6 year agreement covers 460 MW of power and yields about $16 million in annual revenue per MW. Both Google and Microsoft pursued the Monarch site before the Nvidia-backed Nscale signed the initial deal with Anthropic.
